mainText: Hello, Verona! At 8 PM, we have clear skies and a temperature of 58 degrees near Verona Area High School, with an overnight low of 48 degrees and no rain in the forecast. Under the full moon, keep an eye on the sky at 8:34 PM to spot the space station as it travels from the Cross Plains area toward Oregon.

The city has announced that a portion of Hwy M will be closed from October 5 through October 7 for final paving and road markings near the future Aldi site, with traffic detoured to Old PB, E Verona Ave, and S Main St. Also, the city reminds residents to be wary of phishing scams regarding planning fees, noting that official correspondence will only come from a veronawi.gov email address.

It is a busy weekend starting with the Dane County Farmer's Market today. You can also catch live music today at Bailey's Run, Paddy Mac's, and Wisconsin Brewing Company, while next week brings Yoga at Insight Wellness on September 28 and trivia nights at local spots like Hop Haus and Paddy Mac's.

In our weekly recap, on September 10, officers responded to a burglary in the 600 block of Hunters Cove Way where a 19-year-old male was taken into custody after a shot was fired and the suspect sustained a window-related injury.
Culver's of Verona is currently open until 10:30 PM, so stop by to enjoy their delicious Flavor of the Day, OREO REESE'S Cheesecake.
